title: Claire Redfield's promise to Sherry in Resident Evil 2
subject: claire
description:
Should Claire have let the government take Sherry? 👇

The girl Claire Redfield carried out of Raccoon City, and the man who ended up raising her. Spoilers for Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 6.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Twelve-year-old Sherry Birkin had a monster growing inside her.
Her father William had injected himself with the G-virus. In the sewers, he left an embryo inside her.
Claire was a college student, not a cop. She stayed with Sherry anyway.
Sherry's mother Annette told her where the cure was: a lab beneath the city.
Claire got the vaccine before the lab blew. On the escape train, William came for them one last time.
Sherry lived. Then the government took her, with Derek Simmons as guardian, a man Claire distrusted. In Resident Evil 6, Simmons was behind the Tall Oaks outbreak.
